nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime, write $v_p(a)$ for the $p$-adic valuation of an integer $a$, let $f \in \mathbb{Z}[X]$ be a nonzero polynomial with $a_n$ the coefficient of $X^n$ in $f$, and let $v_p(f) = \min \{ v_p(a_n) : a_n \neq 0 \}$ be its $p$-adic valuation. If $k$ is a natural number with $k \le v_p(a_n)$ for every $n$ with $a_n \neq 0$, then $k \le v_p(f)$.
nodes.title: Lower bounds for the valuation of a polynomial

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime and let $f \in \mathbb{Z}_p[X]$ have nonzero reduction modulo $p$. Then for every $x_0 \in \mathbb{Z}_p$ there are a natural number $e$ and a polynomial $g \in \mathbb{Z}_p[X]$ with nonzero reduction modulo $p$ such that $g(X) = p^{-e} f(x_0 + pX)$ as polynomials over $\mathbb{Q}_p$; that is, dilatation data for $f$ at $x_0$ exist.
nodes.title: Existence of dilatations of p-adic polynomials

nodes.summary: For every prime $p$, the exponent $e = 0$ and the polynomial $g = 1$ form dilatation data for the constant polynomial $1 \in \mathbb{Z}_p[X]$ at the point $x_0 = 0$.
nodes.title: Dilatation of the constant polynomial one at zero

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime, $f \in \mathbb{Z}_p[X]$ and $x_0 \in \mathbb{Z}_p$. Dilatation data for $f$ at $x_0$ consist of a natural number $e$ and a polynomial $g \in \mathbb{Z}_p[X]$ such that $g(X) = p^{-e} f(x_0 + pX)$ as polynomials over $\mathbb{Q}_p$, and the reduction of $g$ modulo $p$ is nonzero.
nodes.title: Dilatation of a p-adic polynomial at a point

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime and let $a$ be a nonzero integer. The $p$-adic valuation of the constant polynomial $a \in \mathbb{Z}[X]$, the minimum of the $p$-adic valuations of its nonzero coefficients, equals the $p$-adic valuation $v_p(a)$ of the integer $a$.
nodes.title: The valuation of a nonzero constant polynomial

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime, write $v_p(a)$ for the $p$-adic valuation of an integer $a$, let $f \in \mathbb{Z}[X]$ be a nonzero polynomial with $a_n$ the coefficient of $X^n$ in $f$, and let $v_p(f) = \min \{ v_p(a_n) : a_n \neq 0 \}$ be its $p$-adic valuation. If $a_n \neq 0$, then $v_p(f) \le v_p(a_n)$.
nodes.title: The valuation of a polynomial is at most that of each nonzero coefficient

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime and let $f \in \mathbb{Z}[X]$ be a nonzero polynomial, with $a_n$ the coefficient of $X^n$ in $f$. Writing $v_p(a)$ for the $p$-adic valuation of an integer $a$, the $p$-adic valuation of $f$ is the natural number $v_p(f) = \min \{ v_p(a_n) : a_n \neq 0 \}$.
nodes.title: The $p$-adic valuation of an integer polynomial

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
